summary: Comprehensive architectural implementation plan to construct a resilient, bilingual (English & Akan Twi), safety-guarded conversational AI brain for Ɔkwankyerɛfo Pa. Establishes single-turn Gemini reasoning with local deterministic fallback, cryptographic PII redaction tokenization, unified model configuration with active Gemini catalog verification, strict stateful multi-turn memory with revocation invariants, a zero-PIN voice boundary, and a rigorous Ghanaian speech/text evaluation benchmark.
